preconditions.description: The number of rows in the field is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of columns in the field is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The field has at least 2 squares, ensuring the journey is possible.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of teleporters is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1, x2 <= n and 1 <= y1, y2 <= m for each teleporter)
postconditions.description: The coordinates of each teleporter are within the bounds of the field.

postconditions.expression: all(x1 != x2 or y1 != y2 for each teleporter)
postconditions.description: No teleporter leads to the same square it is installed on.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for each square in the journey) for each journey line)
postconditions.description: The journey path visits only squares within the bounds of the field.

postconditions.expression: the journey starts and ends at (1, 1)
postconditions.description: The journey path starts and ends at the capital.

postconditions.expression: the journey visits the capital exactly two times
postconditions.description: The journey path visits the capital twice, once at the beginning and once at the end.

postconditions.expression: every square (except the capital) is visited exactly once
postconditions.description: The journey path visits every other square exactly once.

postconditions.expression: the journey can be completed using the teleporters
postconditions.description: The journey path can be completed using the minimum number of teleporters.
